nameEn: Manufacture of basic precious and other non-ferrous metals
description: This class includes the manufacture of basic precious and other non-ferrous metals from ore, pig or scrap.
includes: production of aluminium from electrolytic refining of aluminium waste and scrap
semi-manufacturing of aluminium: plates, sheets, strip, foil, tubes, pipes, wire, bars, rods, profiles
production of copper from copper ore or copper matte
production of copper by electrolytic refining of copper waste and scrap
semi-manufacturing of copper: plates, sheets, strip, foil, tubes, pipes, wire, bars, rods, profiles
production of lead, zinc, tin and other non-ferrous metals from ores, concentrates or scrap
production of precious metals: silver, gold, platinum group metals from ores or scrap
production of uranium metal from pitchblende or other ores
excludes: manufacture of non-ferrous metal wire from drawn wire, see 2599
manufacture of jewellery and related articles, see 3211
